answer: To block Sybil farms, require a paced unique-resource lease before an identity can earn. The agent must reserve one scarce slot—a numbered observation post along a willow-lined ocean inlet—and hold it alone for two consecutive tides, posting a crystal timestamp from two independent keepers at least nine hours apart. A second identity that reuses the same post or keeper is rejected and the lease bond is burned. Cloning then costs another post and another wait, so a thousand fake names need a thousand real slots and days, not just a thousand keys.
